documents.title: Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, with standalone revenue of INR 247.03 crores and consolidated revenue of INR 269.23 crores, reflecting Y-o-Y growth driven primarily by mix change. Management highlighted continuing demand momentum, expansion plans including an additional line in the current premises, and ongoing evaluations for an international plant. Margin performance was impacted by raw material price volatility and high freight costs, while the company maintained cautious optimism for the long term. Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results, highlighting growth in standalone and consolidated revenue, profit before tax, and profit after tax. Management discussed raw material price trends for paste PVC and yarn, noting that availability issues have been resolved.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth to be between 8% and 10%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%.

guidance.claim: Management expects export growth to range from 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 15% growth rate in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management targets an average value growth of 15% for the next two years.
guidance.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

demand_outlook.claim: Footwear segment demand was muted in the last quarter due to drastic increases in raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter. So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Recent FTAs signed by India are viewed as a very positive move that will increase cost effectiveness and customer procurement sentiments from Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the polyurethane business is still muted and has not succeeded much in volume or sales increases.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: The company does not receive fixed orders from customers but relies on projections adjusted monthly.
demand_outlook.quote: So, actually, we don't get fixed orders from customers it's all projections and they say this is the volume on each platform and obviously those projections get adjusted on a monthly basis based on their demand also.

demand_outlook.claim: European automotive industry is experiencing degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

demand_outlook.claim: Footwear business growth is impacted due to local competition and low price margin.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional production line has been ordered for current premises with production expected to start towards the end of February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that international plant location options include Mexico, the US, or other NAFTA areas.
capex_expansion.quote: So it could be in Mexico, it could be in U.S., it could be in some other NAFTA areas. We are still considering various options, but there's so much of volatility in the market.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a coating line to be placed in an existing facility instead of putting it in South India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here. So, our capacity will increase.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex for a global location would be around INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant takes approximately two years to start after a decision is finalized, initially starting at 500,000 millimetres per month.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start. And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned infrastructure for the South plant will have a capacity to make 1 million millimetres per month.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the infrastructure will be ready, but the line will be added into...

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have experienced sharp volatility, rising, falling, and increasing again since March.
margins_costs.quote: The prices went up very sharply, then there was a fall in prices of some raw materials. Then again, the prices went up again. So, it's been a very volatile situation.

margins_costs.claim: A 10% natural hedge occurred on US dollar exports due to currency appreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Right? If today I was selling material for US$8 and I was having realization of 85 to 86, so at 94 I was getting a 10% natural hedge.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for petroleum by-products like paste PVC went up significantly, but prices have softened a little bit from the highs of March.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now. And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses decreased in the quarter due to lower freight costs and controlled repair, maintenance, and consumable costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yea, other expenses have decreased in this quarter because of two reasons only. Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

margins_costs.claim: Foreign exchange gain accounted for around 50% of other income, with the remainder coming from treasury income.
margins_costs.quote: This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

margins_costs.claim: Imports normally account for nearly 1/3 of total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is running between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The upcoming capacity addition of 5 lakh meters will provide around 150 crores more per year annually based on average prices.
orders_capacity.quote: So just simple, like if you just add 5 lakh meters into INR300 linear meter average price, so it will just give you the -- it's around INR150 crores more per year annually, then we have some capacity in an additional facility also.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 31 million meters in volume for FY26, representing a volume growth of approximately 5%.
The new coating line is expected to increase average monthly capacity by 5 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that. So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter was 76.3 lakh meters, including PU volume of 2.56 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged market volatility, Trump tariffs, and West Asia war as reasons making it difficult to decide on exact plant locations.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that short-term price increases impact the company until price hikes are passed on to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management notes the world is moving towards deglobalization as a consideration for evaluation.
risks_headwinds.quote: But world is moving towards deglobalization also. So as a counter measure, those things we are evaluating to put up a plant somewhere, not taking a final call there, but somewhere outside India definitely.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that sales growth and increased momentum from US OEM supply orders are expected to continue.
management_commitments.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the newly ordered expansion line in the current premises is planned to start between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the new coating line to be installed by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects increased export momentum to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
